job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Grand Rapids retirement systems RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. It does not state a five-year consultant retention term or a seven-year ceiling. Its five-year figure concerns minimum experience, not retention.
quotes: CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS GENERAL RETIREMENT SYSTEM CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS POLICE AND FIRE RETIREMENT SYSTEM INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (“RFP”)
The Investment Consultant must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in providing institutional investor consulting services.
